descriptionChirho: Indeclinable cardinal numeral 'forty', the most frequently used round number in biblical narrative, often signifying a period of testing, judgment, or generation. Used with שָׁנָה 'year' (wilderness wandering, Deut 1:3, Judg 5:8, 1 Sam 4:18), יוֹם 'day' (the Flood Gen 7:4, 7:12, 7:17; Moses on Sinai Exod 24:18; Elijah's journey 1 Kgs 19:8), and in counting people, animals, and measures across 129+ attestations. The article form הָאַרְבָּעִים functions as ordinal 'the fortieth' (Gen 18:29, Num 33:38, 1 Chr 26:31). All auto-split clusters (bare, with article, with prepositions ב/כ) represent the single numeral forty in different syntactic positions. Multilingual glosses are perfectly uniform: arb أربعين, deu vierzig, fra quarante, hin चालीस, kor 사십, spa cuarenta.
